plan.notes: Official ASU major map (Political Science, BA, plan ASPOLBA, campus ASU00); term-by-term sequence as published; retrieved 2026-10-06. One map row = one seed slot. 'X or Y' alternatives transcribed as one choice slot (choice=true). Rows with large option pools transcribed as one choice slot naming the requirement. Gen-ed placeholders (no course link on the map) transcribed verbatim as choice slots. Map 'Term hours subtotal' rows are metadata, not courses (wave-33 convention). The official map lists the following slot(s) in more than one term; transcribed as shown with allow_repeated_courses per the genuine-repeat rule: Complete 2 courses: Elective; Complete 2 courses: Upper Division Elective; ENG 101 OR ENG 102: First-Year Composition OR ENG 105: Advanced First-Year Composition OR ENG 107 OR ENG 108: First-Year Composition; Elective; Humanities, Arts and Design (HUAD); POS 110: American Government and Politics (AMIT OR SB) OR POS 150: Comparative Government (GCSI OR SB & G) OR POS 160: Global Politics (GCSI OR SB & G) OR POS 210: Political Ideologies (CIVI OR SB); SBS 302: Qualitative Methods OR SBS 304: Social Statistics I (QTRS OR CS); Scientific Thinking in Natural Sciences (SCIT); Upper Division Global and Civic Engagement Requirement: satisfied through completion of 6 credits of upper-division courses with a Global Communities, Societies and Individuals (GCSI) or Governance and Civic Engagement (CIVI) designation, in addition to the courses used to meet the university General Studies requirements; or completion of 3 credits from an ASU-approved Global Education program. Adjustment to upper-division and elective hours is required if a lower-division Global Education course is used..
